answer: Re-attestations are stored in atlas and forge lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the pearl graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 5 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 582 impostors cost 565 times the honest price and take 30 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
